subtitulo: Recognition only: choose the action, never the pronunciation
introPt: You are moving through a terminal and a public building. Hear the six sign surfaces once, then choose the action each one controls.
cenario: A traveller resolves doors, a queue, toilets, opening hours and a restricted route without producing Spanish.

perguntas.pergunta: SALIDA is above one side of a divided doorway. What do you do?
The manual door says EMPUJE. Which movement follows?
opcoes: Wait for it to open automatically
perguntas.explica: EMPUJE means push; JALE means pull in this Mexican set.

perguntas.pergunta: A line ends at a window marked TAQUILLA. What comes first?
opcoes: Join the back of the FILA
perguntas.explica: FILA marks the queue; TAQUILLA identifies the ticket window.

perguntas.pergunta: A place lists HORARIO and a separate ÚLTIMO ACCESO. Which controls entry?
perguntas.explica: ÚLTIMO ACCESO is the entry deadline and may be earlier than closing.

perguntas.pergunta: A shortcut says SOLO PERSONAL. What is the safe action?
opcoes: Stop and choose a public route
perguntas.explica: SOLO PERSONAL marks a staff-only boundary.
